verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer has built ChatGD, an in-house generative AI chat app on an enterprise Azure OpenAI instance. Attorneys can use it to query and manipulate documents, and can supply agreements as RAG context. However, the evidence describes it only as a tool for the firm's own lawyers. Nothing shows clients can delegate tasks to an AI assistant inside Catalyze, GDHQ or the Contract Generator. Missing for 10: a client-facing built-in AI assistant, evidence of task delegation or agentic actions beyond chat and document querying, in-depth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
